sql.tournament.getTournaments: select * from brs.tournament t where archived is not true
sql.tournament.getOwnerTypes: select * from brs.tournament_owner_type where archived is not true
sql.tournament.delete: update brs.tournament set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where id = :id
sql.tournament.update: update brs.tournament set tournament_name = :tournamentName, tournament_owner_type_id = :tournamentOwnerTypeId, start_date = :startDate, end_date = :endDate, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.tournament.insert: insert into brs.tournament(tournament_name, tournament_owner_type_id, start_date, end_date, created_by_id) values(:tournamentName, :tournamentOwnerTypeId, :startDate, :endDate, :userId)
sql.tournament.getActiveTournaments: select * from brs.tournament t where now() between start_date and end_date and archived is not true
sql.tournament.get: select t.*, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(tb))) FROM ( SELECT tb.id, tb.tournament_id as "tournamentId", tb.matches_generated as "matchesGenerated", tb.number_of_users as "numberOfUsers", tb.archived, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(tb))) FROM ( SELECT tr.id, tr.tournament_bracket_id as "tournamentBracketId", tr.start_date as "startDate", tr.end_date as "endDate", tr.archived, now() between tr.start_date and tr.end_date as "currentRound", row_number() over (order by tr.start_date) as "roundNumber", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(tb))) FROM ( SELECT tm.id, tm.tournament_round_id as "tournamentRoundId", tm.user_1_id as "user1Id", tm.user_1_score as "user1Score", concat(u1.first_name, ' ', u1.last_name) as "user1Name", tm.user_2_id as "user2Id", tm.user_2_score as "user2Score", concat(u2.first_name, ' ', u2.last_name) as "user2Name", tm.archived FROM brs.tournament_match tm left join flow."user" u1 on u1.id = tm.user_1_id left join flow."user" u2 on u2.id = tm.user_2_id WHERE tm.tournament_round_id = tr.id AND tm.archived is not true order by tm.id) tb), '[]') AS "matches" FROM brs.tournament_round tr WHERE tr.tournament_bracket_id = tb.id AND tr.archived is not true order by tr.start_date) tb), '[]') AS "rounds" FROM brs.tournament_bracket tb WHERE tb.tournament_id = t.id AND tb.archived is not true ) tb), '[]') AS "brackets" from brs.tournament t where id = :id
sql.tournament.getBracket: SELECT tb.id, tb.tournament_id as "tournamentId", tb.matches_generated, tb.number_of_users as "numberOfUsers", tb.archived, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(tb))) FROM ( SELECT tr.id, tr.tournament_bracket_id as "tournamentBracketId", tr.start_date as "startDate", tr.end_date as "endDate", tr.archived, now() between tr.start_date and tr.end_date as "currentRound", row_number() over (order by tr.start_date) as "roundNumber", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(tb))) FROM ( SELECT tm.id, tm.tournament_round_id as "tournamentRoundId", tm.user_1_id as "user1Id", tm.user_1_score as "user1Score", concat(u1.first_name, ' ', u1.last_name) as "user1Name", tm.user_2_id as "user2Id", tm.user_2_score as "user2Score", concat(u2.first_name, ' ', u2.last_name) as "user2Name", tm.archived FROM brs.tournament_match tm left join flow."user" u1 on u1.id = tm.user_1_id left join flow."user" u2 on u2.id = tm.user_2_id WHERE tm.tournament_round_id = tr.id AND tm.archived is not true order by tm.id) tb), '[]') AS "matches" FROM brs.tournament_round tr WHERE tr.tournament_bracket_id = tb.id AND tr.archived is not true order by tr.start_date) tb), '[]') AS "rounds" FROM brs.tournament_bracket tb WHERE tb.id = :id
sql.tournament.deleteBracket: update brs.tournament_bracket set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where id = :id
sql.tournament.addBracket: insert into brs.tournament_bracket(tournament_id, number_of_users, created_by_id) values (:tournamentId, :numberOfUsers, :createdById)
sql.tournament.deleteRound: update brs.tournament_round set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where id = :id
sql.tournament.addRound: insert into brs.tournament_round(start_date, end_date, created_by_id, tournament_bracket_id) values(:startDate, :endDate, :userId, :bracketId)
sql.tournament.updateRound: update brs.tournament_round set start_date = :startDate, end_date = :endDate, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where id = :id
